narration:0:1029517001:0.text:
Taking in the malt nectar proffered by the Celestial Dionel, its refreshing wheat fragrance swirls like an autumnal October breeze.
Your thoughts are submerged in beautiful memories of fruit, wheat fields, clouds, and fallen leaves.
Just a slight sip brings you this wonderful dream.
narration:0:1029517001:0.source_cn: 接过半神萨基塔里斯的麦芽露，清爽的麦香如十月秋风掠过鼻...
